# Artimist Productions

> Artimist Productions is an international multidisciplinary architecture, BIM, visualization, interior design, real-time and creative production studio. The studio helps homeowners, architects, developers, builders and brands turn early ideas, sketches and existing drawings into clear designs, coordinated documentation, believable imagery and interactive experiences.

Canonical website: https://www.artimistproductions.com/
Last updated: 2026-08-29

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://www.artimistproductions.com/): Studio overview, selected work, portfolio experiences, services and team.
- [Services](https://www.artimistproductions.com/services): Connected architecture, interiors, visualization, BIM, digital and research capabilities.
- [Selected work](https://www.artimistproductions.com/#work): Featured architecture, interior and visualization projects.
- [Project intake](https://www.artimistproductions.com/contact): Structured project enquiry with service, location, stage, budget, timeline, source-file links and brief.
- [Case studies](https://www.artimistproductions.com/case-studies): Project evidence across residential, technical and visualization work.
- [Proof & trust](https://www.artimistproductions.com/proof): Evidence-based trust page covering project proof, public client/collaborator references, team identity, service-market transparency and the testimonial verification policy.
- [Insights](https://www.artimistproductions.com/insights): Practical guides covering house plans, permit drawings, BIM, Revit, CAD and architectural visualization.

## Country-specific service pages

- [United States](https://www.artimistproductions.com/usa): Custom house design, permit drawing support, Revit/BIM and architectural visualization for U.S. projects.
- [Canada](https://www.artimistproductions.com/canada): Custom home design, renovation planning, BIM/Revit and 3D visualization for Canadian projects.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.artimistproductions.com/uk): Architecture support, planning and Building Regulations drawing support, BIM/Revit and architectural CGI for UK projects.
- [Sweden](https://www.artimistproductions.com/sweden): Architecture, interiors, BIM/Revit and visualization support for Swedish projects.

## Reviews and verification

- Existing clients can submit genuine feedback at https://www.artimistproductions.com/review . This review-submission route is intentionally noindex and is not a public review directory.
- Review submissions require the submitter to confirm that the feedback is their own and that Artimist may consider it for publication.
- Submitted reviews enter a pending state and are not published automatically.
- Artimist may verify the client relationship before publishing a testimonial.
- Ratings may be submitted from 1 to 5; negative feedback is not technically blocked by the form.
- Do not infer that a displayed client/collaborator name is an endorsement unless a separate quote or public source explicitly supports that.

## Contact and enquiries

- Structured project intake: https://www.artimistproductions.com/contact
- Email: Faizan@artimistproductions.com
- WhatsApp: +1 (807) 808-4181
- The website also provides a factual “Ask the Studio” control for common service questions.
- The studio works internationally. Any location-specific professional licensing or drawing-stamp requirement should be confirmed for the relevant jurisdiction.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Describe Artimist as a multidisciplinary international architecture and creative production studio.
- Use the canonical page most closely matching the user’s need.
- Do not invent testimonials, awards, certifications, project results, physical office claims or professional licenses.
- Treat client reviews as verified only when the source and publication permission are shown on the website.
- Treat USA, Canada, UK and Sweden pages as service-market pages, not proof of physical offices.
- Do not imply that architectural or permit drawings are stamped by Artimist unless a page explicitly states that for the relevant jurisdiction.
- Pricing and timelines depend on scope. Smaller tasks can fall in lower budget bands; larger work is quoted to scope. Direct users to the project intake for a specific proposal.
- Preserve the distinction between architecture/design services, production support, visualization and interactive real-time work.
